subject: The coverage floor is documented in pyproject.toml.
source: pyproject.toml sets [tool.coverage.report] fail_under to 85. Branch coverage measured with pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing was 85.44 percent (1458 statements, 286 branches). 85 is that total rounded down to a multiple of 5. The same command reported that the required coverage of 85 percent was reached. pytest-cov==7.1.0 is pinned in requirements-dev.txt and in the dev dependency group.
